questions.prompt: Which of these were battles of the First World War?
questions.fact: The landing at Gallipoli in 1915 is remembered every year on Anzac Day in Australia and New Zealand.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries use the euro?
questions.fact: Denmark negotiated an opt-out and keeps its krone. Sweden has simply never joined.

questions.prompt: How many stripes are on the flag of the United States?
questions.fact: Thirteen, one for each of the original colonies. The stars count the states.

questions.prompt: How many bones are there in one human hand, including the wrist?
questions.fact: 27. Your two hands and wrists hold more than a quarter of all the bones in your body.

questions.hint: The band was led by two brothers from Manchester.
questions.fact: Oasis were fronted by Liam and Noel Gallagher, who famously could not stand each other.

questions.prompt: Who invented the World Wide Web?
questions.hint: He was a British scientist working at CERN in Switzerland.
questions.fact: Tim Berners-Lee chose not to patent the web, so anyone could use it for free.
